confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant meal, beer and cappuccino anchors rest on Foz do Iguaçu cost-of-living index figures (Numbeo, Expatistan, Citycost) dated late 2026 and applied to a July 2026 window. These are user-submitted or modelled and approximate, so they are the most reliable anchors. Cocktail and wine have no Foz-specific figure: they follow the local draft-beer relationship (about 2.5x and 2.8x the beer anchor), checked against Rio bar price ranges. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge and Foz's Iguazu Falls tourism context, including July school-holiday demand. No accommodation prices were searched and no live listings were inspected, so it is low confidence. Local-currency figures were converted at an assumed rate of about R$5.6 per US$ (sources imply roughly R$5.3 to R$5.8), not a live quote.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food, beer and coffee anchors reflect Foz do Iguaçu index figures cross-checked against Brazil-wide averages. Cocktail and wine use the local beer relationship, with Rio de Janeiro bar price ranges as a weak reference adjusted for Foz's lower general price level. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized border tourism hub in Paraná state.
